verdicts.reason: A: the decorative confetti is blown up to fill the left 60%, and a giant yellow triangle becomes the main focal point. The orbit graphic is shrunk to a thumbnail, so '11/05' can't be read. The three-line headline and the tiny, crammed description are jammed against the right edge. B: the headline is a small single line with weak presence, and confetti triangles cluster right under it and the address. The description is split off to the far right at illegible size, and the orbit and date are again a tiny unreadable icon, so the layout breaks into scattered fragments. A keeps its text grouped and gives the headline more presence, so it is slightly less bad.
